question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The explorer ventured into the __uncharted __territory in search of adventure.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Undiscovered)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Uncharted"** means an area or topic that has not been explored or mapped; something unknown or unfamiliar. (अज्ञात)

 
 
• **Example:** The team decided to explore the uncharted depths of the ocean in search of rare species.
 
 
 
• **"Undiscovered"** refers to something that has not yet been found or identified. It closely aligns with the meaning of "uncharted," as both imply a lack of exploration or mapping. (अप्रकट)
 
 
• **Example:** The undiscovered island was rumored to be home to a hidden treasure.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym for "uncharted" is **"undiscovered."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Undiscovered)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mapped** (मानचित्रित): Something that has been charted or plotted on a map.

 
 
• **Example:** The mapped regions of the forest are safe for tourists to visit.
 
 
 
• **Explored** (अन्वेषित): Something that has been investigated or traveled through to learn more about it.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist explored the new cave to study its unique rock formations.
 
 
 
• **Familiar** (परिचित): Something well-known or easily recognized.
 
 
• **Example:** The traveler felt at ease when he saw the familiar landmarks of his hometown.
